title: preflight data
description: Whether a network, its proof server and optionally a wallet are ready before the first transaction. ready is true when every check passed.

night.description: NIGHT held, in NIGHT (1 NIGHT = 1,000,000 STAR)

registeredUtxos.description: NIGHT UTXOs registered for DUST generation

resetByUpgrade.description: Unshielded addresses on a network past the Ledger 9 upgrade (its node runs runtime spec 2001100 or later): unregistered NIGHT UTXOs created before the upgrade, whose registration the ledger 8 to 9 fork reset, so they need registering again. 0 when none were; absent on a network that hasn't upgraded

complete.description: false when the address's history couldn't be read before the timeout, so the totals may be short

registered.description: Cardano reward addresses: registered for DUST generation

dust.description: Cardano reward addresses: DUST generated so far, in DUST

expectations.description: What Midnight's examples run on this network measured
